item.title: Persistent Littering, Obstructed Stairs and Health & Safety Concern, 26th August
item.description:
I am reporting an ongoing issue with significant littering on the stairs at this location. I have taken photographs documenting the condition from 13 August 2026 through to today, 26 August 2026. The photos show that the situation has progressively worsened over this period, with people continuing to leave and throw rubbish on the stairs, including clothing, an old blanket, food waste, drinks and other general litter. This is becoming increasingly concerning as it appears the stairs are not being checked or cleaned regularly. The amount of rubbish has continued to accumulate rather than being removed, creating an unpleasant and potentially unhygienic environment. There is also a clear health and safety concern. The litter is being left directly on the steps and is increasingly obstructing the area. When the stairs are busy, pedestrians are unable to use the full width of the stairs safely, increasing the risk of people tripping, falling or having to navigate around the rubbish. I would ask that this location is inspected and cleaned as soon as possible, and that regular checks and cleaning visits are put in place to prevent the problem from continually recurring. The attached photographs provide a clear timeline showing how the situation has deteriorated from 13 August to today. This is no longer simply an issue of untidiness; the accumulation of waste is affecting the safe and practical use of the stairs. Please could this be investigated and appropriate action taken to ensure the stairs are kept clear, safe and regularly maintained.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Elmdene Road, Woolwich
Report on FixMyStreet
